tensor_contract.verification_level: metadata_identity_and_parent_producer_tensor_assertions_only; inspect actual array shapes at first permitted payload read

split_algorithm.subject_rank: SHA256 UTF8 of f"{seed}|{dataset}|{purpose}|{subject}"; ascending hexadecimal order

window_algorithm.round_robin: choose least-used available task, then condition within task, then native EEG record; break ties by seeded SHA256 metadata rank; choose window by stage-specific hash
window_algorithm.visual_policy: group both probes by dataset/subject/native EEG Part/eeg_start_s; retain only complete synchronous triples; admitted Probe1 has motor+prefrontal+posterior; Probe2 lacks motor and is not another independent EEG window
window_algorithm.cross_split_dependency: subject disjoint; all native records, conditions and Probe variants from subject stay in same split
window_algorithm.within_record_overlaps: Single-Trial adjacent 30s windows can overlap; no subject crosses split; aggregate/uncertainty by subject not window independence

All parent subjects and windows previously entered earlier exploratory reconstruction analyses.
Labels/task metadata used only for split/window coverage; downstream task label fitting must be separately recorded.
REFED unavailable on regional feature interface because cross-modal geometry not registered.
Simultaneous admitted DSR subset excludes nine unverified-alignment records.
Visual montage0 coarse template is not subject-specific cortical localization.
